description: Combined malt dataset for site import. Priority to official maltster catalogs (Weyermann, BESTMALZ, Viking Malt) plus selected Beer.RF ingredient records relevant to RU/CIS market (Soufflet, Курский солод, Белсолод, Староминский солод, SELECT MALT, Приволжская мельница, IREKS, Castle Malting, Simpsons).
